roofline.denominator_definition: Quantized matrix bytes and non-quantized weight bytes read once per decode evaluation, KV cache bytes at the average live depth and declared dtype, and one embedding row; excludes re-reads, metadata, and storage padding.

roofline_measured_achievable.denominator_definition: Quantized matrix bytes and non-quantized weight bytes read once per decode evaluation, KV cache bytes at the average live depth and declared dtype, and one embedding row; excludes re-reads, metadata, and storage padding.

notes: The spec roofline uses 1008 GB/s for the RTX 4090.
The measured-achievable roofline uses 930 GB/s. Luo et al., arXiv 2501.12084v2, Table 5, measure 929.8 GB/s on the RTX 4090.
The roofline denominator counts weights read, depth-dependent KV reads, and one embedding row per decode evaluation.
Prompt context repeats token ID 1 for the manifest token count.
One full benchmark repetition runs before the five timed repetitions.
Decode timing includes token D2H, stream synchronization, and allocation-free detokenization.
Prefill uses tiled-cublaslt-fp16 with 2048-token position blocks.
Prefill GEMMs use FP16 inputs and weights, CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F accumulation, and FP32 outputs.
Prefill workspace: 4026540032 bytes total, 100663296 dequantized weights, 50331648 converted activations, 3313500160 attention, 33554432 cuBLASLt, and 528490496 batch activations.
The eval logits path keeps sequential decode prefill and is not the measured prefill subject.
The pp512 comparator comes from receipts/raw/llama-bench-candidate.json.
CUDA quantized GEMV uses 32-value q8_1 activation blocks with f16 scales. Logit KLD near 1e-3 against the scalar f32 activation path is expected.
Lossless Q4_K repack: 410.922 ms once at load for 3704979456 source bytes.
